accent_source.selection: Match intended spelling and reviewed reading; use only explicit semantic spelling aliases. Preserve all listed variants. Never substitute a homophone or the life-history reading of 半生.

reviewNotes: Reviewed all hiragana, long vowels, small kana and geminates against source annotations, existing reviewed readings and intended cooking meaning. Converted only the explicitly listed topic は to わ and contextual object を to お before stripping annotations. No directional へ in this deck: lexical へら and へんしょく remain intact. Preserve lexical は in はかり, はかります, はけ, はっこう, はんなま, ごはん, はめて and はいすいこう. Existing clause commas retained; topic particles stay attached. Short words stay continuous; list separators are speech-only commas. IH uses reviewed あいえいち, not letters. Dictionary lemma references do not verify derived or conjugated accents. Unconfirmed phrases and compounds have authorized provisional natural Tokyo intonation. Source and input review do not prove generated pronunciation/pitch. No listening verification claimed. 焼く and 約 have separate lookup keys and render identities: 焼く type 0, 約 type 1. The approximation recording is generated independently. Re-recorded ten user-reported entries with focused term/phrase guidance. Added speech-only commas after むしきで and だいふきで, retaining particles with their preceding phrases. Preserved display labels and lookup keys. New recordings have not been listening-verified.
